SELECT
  time,
  gps_lat AS lat,
  gps_lon AS lon
FROM sensors_and_gps_data
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND gps_fix_ok IS TRUE
  AND gps_lat IS NOT NULL
  AND gps_lon IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  time,
  gps_lat AS lat,
  gps_lon AS lon
FROM sensors_and_gps_data
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND gps_fix_ok IS TRUE
  AND gps_lat IS NOT NULL
  AND gps_lon IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1
